subject: Night Passage Undertow
review: Inspected native front, side, rear and angled clay and material views, and charge, volley and pulse contact poses.
The squat joined body, pale throat, broad shellback, asymmetric shoulder fins and forked tail distinguish Undertow from the upright bronze Bellwarden.
Inspected six-frame-per-second decoded unretimed charge, volley and pulse playback for preparation, contact and settling; retained the full six-clip 1x movie.
Compared production native and fallback at identical positions and charge warning footprint. The health bar clears the body and the grounded warning remains readable.
Reviewed 960x600 and 390x244 production views. Eye and gill details recede at narrow scale; the teal body, fins and orange charge lane remain readable.

geometryAgreement.sampling: All 237 authored 30fps frames, 16 vertices per named mesh (448 points/frame); whole-surface native floor/IK audit is separate.

limits: Self-review is not user art approval. Ash Regent, Unlit Sovereign and four environment kits remain blockouts.
In-place locomotion has no claim of world-space foot locking at every movement speed; directional locomotion and transition blending remain polish.
Newly loaded mid-action snapshots infer preparation duration when historic enrage timing is unavailable; contact remains tied to the confirmed attack transition.
Six-fps decoded review samples motion; it is not an exhaustive continuous-time anatomical proof.

delegation.ownership: Primary authored native source and integrated/reviewed delivery; two reused workers owned runtime/tests and browser/receipt checks.
delegation.rework: A local Python typecheck required a loop-variable rename; no native geometry repair was needed after first visual review. Both delegated outputs passed integration checks.
delegation.efficiency: Both delegated outputs were used. No measured single-agent time comparison.
